inclusions.text: Private transfer, operated for your party alone
inclusions.source: This is a private transfer, operated for your party alone — never shared with other travellers.
The vehicle is private and air-conditioned, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided for the drive.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The vehicle is private and air-conditioned, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided for the drive.

inclusions.text: Meet-and-greet with representative holding a name sign
inclusions.source: Your representative will be standing in the meet-and-greet area beyond the exit gate, holding a sign bearing the Travel2Egypt name and your own.

exclusions.source: It does not include a guide; this is a point-to-point transfer, not a sightseeing tour.
The USD 25 visa-on-arrival fee is a government charge, not part of the transfer, and cannot be pre-paid through this service.
